changed: Task presets now come from the domain pack (R-3). e_agent.sdk.ports gains TaskPreset (kind, prompt template with named {ref} placeholders, default refs, help; a placeholder without a default is refused at construction) and PluginContribution.task_presets. PluginRegistry collects presets by kind and refuses two different definitions of one kind with STARTUP_REJECTED (PR-09). The ERP domain pack contributes the eight presets that were TASK_PROMPTS in server/cli.py and TASK_KINDS/DEFAULT_REFS in erp/testing/scripted_tasks.py; the scripted driver's TASK_KINDS and DEFAULT_REFS now derive from them. DriverConfig.task_kind is a plain string with no ERP wording; bootstrap refuses a kind no admitted plugin offers, naming the admitted kinds. The CLI renders the demo prompt from the admitted preset (defaults, then driver.refs, then the legacy demand_ref/product_ref), and --task has no static choices. qualify_model.py and capture_model_replays.py take prompts from the presets. A golden file of 36 demo prompts (8 kinds plus the profile default, under four profiles: default, refs, legacy refs, both) was recorded through the CLI's own demo path on the unchanged code (49abd0b) and is unchanged after the change.
